title: string — the module's display name
learningOutcomes: string — one per outcome, phrased as 'learners will be able to...'

sections.sectionId: string — unique within this module, e.g. "s1"
sections.heading: string
sections.body: string — the actual instructional content, plain text or basic markdown

assignments.assignmentId: string — unique within this module, e.g. "a1"
assignments.title: string
assignments.instructions: string — what the learner is asked to do

quizBank.questionId: string — unique within this module, e.g. "q1"
quizBank.correctAnswer: string — must exactly match one entry in options
